column3: ROSA is explicitly a new managed OpenShift service with its own adoption and licensing model.
AMS Accelerate introduces an operations support plan and selectable assistance tiers within existing AMS; the source does not establish a distinct product or execution subsystem.
DNS Firewall adds a managed DNS security subsystem with rule lists, enforcement, alerts and centralized administration.
Amplify Hosting adds dynamic server-side execution and API routes alongside its existing frontend deployment model.
FinSpace is explicitly a new managed financial-data management and analytics service.
DocumentDB gains a multi-region replication and promotion operating model through Global Clusters.
Route 53 gains an application-recovery control subsystem with readiness monitoring and coordinated failover.
FSx for NetApp ONTAP is introduced as a distinct managed storage service offering.
The explicit GA delta introduces alert management and recording/alerting rules plus provisioning controls, rather than a new monitoring product or execution model.
Native event storage, streaming ingestion and label updates add a distinct dataset-management capability within Fraud Detector.
The FreeRTOS kernel gains symmetric multiprocessing scheduling across shared-memory cores.
Athena gains transactional row-level writes and time travel through an ACID table subsystem.
CloudWatch Evidently adds a feature-experimentation and controlled-rollout subsystem with statistical analysis and rollback controls.
EMR Serverless introduces automatically provisioned and scaled application execution without managed clusters.
FSx for OpenZFS is a distinct fully managed file-system offering within the FSx family.
Kinesis gains an on-demand capacity operating mode with automatic scaling and consumption billing.
Microservice Extractor is a standalone downloadable AWS application-analysis and code-extraction tool.
Mainframe Modernization is introduced as a distinct managed migration and runtime platform.
RDS gains a three-instance deployment model with readable standby nodes and changed replication/failover behavior.
Lookout for Vision adds on-device model execution and deployment beyond its cloud inference API.
Ground Truth Plus is explicitly a new turnkey labeling service offering with managed workflow and workforce.
SageMaker gains an automatically provisioned, scaled and stopped serverless inference execution model.
Amplify Studio adds a visual UI-generation and data-binding development subsystem alongside backend management.
GameSparks is explicitly a new managed game-backend service.
GuardDuty gains a malware-file scanning subsystem for EBS-backed compute workloads.
WorkSpaces Core is explicitly a new managed VDI infrastructure service integrated with external VDI management.
ECS gains a service-connectivity subsystem combining endpoint discovery, traffic routing, telemetry and draining.
EventBridge introduces a managed Scheduler capability for creating and executing one-time and recurring tasks; the source does not establish a new execution model for EventBridge itself.

MemoryDB introduces automatic hot/cold data tiering as a storage-management capability; a new internal storage layer and larger capacity alone do not establish a major product operating-model expansion.
Omics is explicitly a new managed omics data storage, workflow and analytics service.
SageMaker gains an integrated geospatial data-processing, modeling and map-analysis subsystem.
OpenSearch gains a serverless operating model with independently scaled indexing and query compute.
Glue gains the Ray distributed Python execution engine and programming model.
AWS Supply Chain is a distinct cloud application combining supply-chain data, insights and collaboration.
Application Composer is introduced as a standalone visual serverless application authoring tool.
Step Functions gains distributed Map execution coordinating thousands of parallel child workflows.
GuardDuty gains an on-host runtime-monitoring agent and detection subsystem beyond audit-log analysis.
Lightsail for Research is explicitly positioned as a new research-computing offering with bundled applications and pricing.
OpenSearch gains a security analytics subsystem with detectors, rules, findings and investigation workflows.
DataZone is explicitly a new data catalog, sharing and governance service.
OpenSearch gains an independently managed serverless ingestion and transformation tier.
Bedrock agents add managed task planning, orchestration and action execution beyond model inference.
OpenSearch Serverless gains a vector engine for embedding indexing, mutation and hybrid retrieval.
Dedicated Local Zones is a distinct customer-exclusive infrastructure offering with location and governance configuration.
Bedrock Knowledge Bases adds a managed RAG ingestion and runtime retrieval subsystem.
MSK gains a managed cross-cluster replication subsystem that scales replication resources and preserves Kafka metadata for failover.
OpenSearch 2.9 adds distinct search pipelines, ML integration and correlation capabilities; multiple new features alone do not establish a new product execution model.
Search Pipelines adds configurable query and result processing operations within the existing search engine.
Optimized Reads improves existing query and cache performance through local SSD-backed instance options; the text does not introduce a new user operation or product execution model.
Bedrock gains a reusable safety-policy subsystem applying topic and harmful-content controls across models and agents.
CloudFront gains a globally distributed key-value storage subsystem with independently managed data resources usable by functions.
Application Signals adds an integrated instrumentation, application-observation and SLO-management subsystem.
ElastiCache gains a serverless capacity and management model with automatic scaling and a single endpoint.
FSx ONTAP gains a scale-out file-system operating model spanning multiple HA server pairs.
Managed Prometheus gains agentless metric discovery and collection as a new managed ingestion capability.
Amazon One Enterprise is introduced as a distinct biometric enterprise-access service and device offering.
Oracle Multitenant adds multiple pluggable databases as a configuration of existing RDS container databases, a consolidation option rather than a new database service.
S3 Access Grants introduces identity-to-dataset permission mapping and identity-aware access management within S3.
HyperPod adds managed distributed-training infrastructure with automatic checkpoint-based failure recovery.

Transcribe adds call-analysis operations for sentiment, categorization, conversation characteristics and redaction; these extend its speech-processing capability rather than establishing a new execution model.
Adds orchestrated post-upload workflow execution with custom Lambda steps and monitoring.
Adds a SQL Server protocol and T-SQL execution compatibility layer to PostgreSQL, including stored procedures and transaction semantics.
Adds automatic hot/cold data tiering; larger capacity and internal storage design alone do not establish a major product expansion.
The same readable-standby model was announced in preview on 2021-11-23; this availability post does not identify a substantive launch delta.
Introduces indexed lazy-loading container startup and a supporting containerd snapshotter.
Introduces graph-query operations over digital-twin entities and relationships, without establishing a broader operating model.
Adds subscription-based third-party API access with invocation, entitlement and billing integration.
Adds pulse-level quantum programming and execution alongside gate-based programs.
Adds automatic tiered storage for retention; independent capacity scaling is a benefit of that capability, not sufficient alone for level 4.
Adds a deep-learning training execution stack with compilation, debugging and distributed training beyond prior inference use.
Adds role generation, model documentation and monitoring capabilities; their combined release does not alone establish a major subsystem.
Adds checkpoint-based fault-tolerant query execution with intermediate-data retries.
Adds a real-time multi-participant stage subsystem alongside broadcast channels.
Introduces a security-analytics subsystem with attack detection, findings and threat investigation beyond a routine version update.
Adds a dedicated provisioned-compute operating mode with workload allocation and isolation.
Amplify Gen 2 introduces a code-first backend programming and deployment model with per-developer sandboxes.
CodeBuild gains Lambda as a distinct build execution mode.
Mainframe Modernization gains a functional-equivalence testing subsystem with capture, replay, comparison and regression workflows.
Research and Engineering Studio is a standalone open-source research-environment management portal, not a sample template.
OR1 adds an optimized instance family with higher performance and durability; an internal storage redesign does not itself establish a larger user-facing product change.
MemoryDB gains a vector indexing and search subsystem beyond its existing key-value operations.
Managed kdb gains tickerplant clusters for real-time feed distribution, logging and recovery, a new processing subsystem.
EMR adds managed HBase backup and recovery operations using durable WAL storage; the recovery benefit does not itself establish a new execution model.
Supply Chain gains a supply-planning module for material and inventory purchase/placement recommendations.
CloudFront gains an ISP-embedded infrastructure deployment model and associated lifecycle-management portal.
EMR Serverless gains a continuous streaming-job execution mode with resilient long-running lifecycle management.
AppSync Events introduces a serverless event publish/subscribe API subsystem with managed WebSocket connections and scaling.
Step Functions adds workflow variables and a JSONata transformation interface within its existing state-machine execution model.
Bedrock Guardrails adds policy-based logical validation and explanation of model responses; the underlying reasoning technique does not by itself establish a major product expansion.
Bedrock Marketplace adds a provisioned model deployment and access subsystem using configurable SageMaker endpoints, beyond simply adding model catalog entries.
EKS Hybrid Nodes introduces a hybrid operating model combining AWS-managed control planes with customer on-premises and edge nodes.
S3 Tables introduces table buckets and a managed transactional Iceberg table subsystem with maintenance policies.
SageMaker gains a broad DataZone-based governance subsystem for data and AI discovery, permissions, sharing and trust.
QuickSight gains an agent-assisted scenario-analysis workspace with iterative multi-step analysis and reusable execution paths.
OpenSearch gains customer-supplied search and analysis plugin execution with package validation and domain lifecycle management.
Quantum Embark is an expert-led advisory and technical-enablement program, not a changed AWS product operation.
Bedrock Data Automation introduces a configurable multimodal content-processing subsystem with unified inference and knowledge-base integration.
Q Developer gains an end-to-end mainframe transformation subsystem covering discovery, planning, decomposition and autonomous COBOL refactoring.
SageMaker gains a managed partner-application deployment and execution subsystem inside its private environment.
Security Incident Response is explicitly a new service combining automated investigation, incident collaboration and dedicated response expertise.
The next SageMaker generation integrates major unified development, lakehouse and governance subsystems into a broader data-and-AI platform.
Oracle Database at AWS is a distinct jointly positioned managed database offering with its own purchase and resource-management experience.
